steps.instruction: Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 1 1/2 pounds of thinly sliced beef or lamb to the hot skillet.
Stir-fry for 3 minutes, until browned and cooked through.
steps.spoken: Stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes, until the meat is browned and cooked through.

steps.instruction: Take the meat out of the skillet and set it aside.
In the same skillet, add 1 sliced onion and 3 cloves of minced garlic.
Stir-fry for 2 minutes, until the onion is clear and smells good.
steps.spoken: Stir-fry for 2 to 3 minutes, until the onion is clear and smells good.

steps.instruction: Add 2 tablespoons of berbere spice and 1 tablespoon of tomato paste.
Add 1 tablespoon of paprika and 1 tablespoon of cayenne pepper.
Stir well to coat the onions and garlic with the spices.
Return the beef or lamb to the skillet and toss it with the onion mixture.
Add 1 tablespoon each of awaze sauce, soy sauce and vinegar, and 1 teaspoon of salt.
Stir everything together to coat the meat evenly.
Keep stir-frying for 2 minutes, until the sauce thickens and coats the meat.
steps.spoken: Keep stir-frying for another 2 to 3 minutes, until the sauce thickens and coats the meat.

steps.instruction: Taste and adjust the seasoning with salt or more spices.
Take the skillet off the heat.
